notes.title: Quiet on Set Releasing March 7!
notes.content:
🎬 Quiet on Set Coming Tomorrow! 🎥

We are proud to finally announce that after a long delay, Quiet on Set is releasing tomorrow March 7!

Lights, camera, action – see you on set!

notes.title: Quiet on Set Delay
notes.content:
Hello future sleuths,

We are writing to share an important update regarding the release of our highly anticipated game.

Initially scheduled for this Friday, the 15th, our dedicated team has been tirelessly working towards meeting this ambitious deadline. However, unforeseen technical challenges affecting the stability of the game have led us to make a difficult decision.

In our commitment to delivering a top-tier gaming experience, we have decided to postpone the release to ensure the game meets the high standards we set for ourselves. Quality is paramount to us, and we want to avoid any potential negative impact on the player experience.

The new release date is set for [b]Friday, January 19th 2024[/b]. We understand the excitement surrounding the game's launch, and we sincerely appreciate your patience and support during this time. 

We acknowledge that this news may be disappointing, but rest assured it is a necessary step to provide you with the best possible gaming experience. We firmly believe that taking the time to refine and perfect the game will result in a product that exceeds your expectations.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

notes.title: Quiet on Set Release Date
notes.content:
🎬🔍 Get Ready to Uncover the Clues and Secrets in Quiet on Set! Release Date Announced: December 15th, 2023! 🔍🎬

🌟 Why December 15th?
December 15th marks the grand premiere of "Quiet on Set," delivering an early holiday gift to mystery enthusiasts and gaming connoisseurs alike. As the winter chill sets in, warm up with a thrilling adventure that will keep you guessing until the final credits roll.

👉 Wishlist now to be notified on release day!

notes.title: NextFest Demo Stream
notes.content:
🎬 Exciting News for NextFest! 🎮

We're thrilled to announce that the Quiet on Set Demo is now available for your enjoyment.

Join us for a special live streaming event where you can engage with the game's developers and have all your burning questions answered.

During the stream, we'll take you on an immersive journey through one of two captivating stories, guiding you on gameplay and providing valuable insights into uncovering clues.

Don't miss out! The entire Quiet on Set team is eagerly anticipating the opportunity to showcase this thrilling experience to you!

Save the date and stay tuned for more details!
